findings.summary: data-testid=spotlight-board is load-bearing for the regression test's failure mode (without it the test times out on locator-not-found instead of reporting escaping names) but nothing documents that dependency, risking a silent test degradation if a future refactor strips it as apparently-decorative

regression test runs at the kudos-board project's default viewport (1280x720) rather than literally 1440 as the acceptance criterion states; the fix is viewport-independent and a 1440 screenshot corroborates it, so this is a wording/coverage nuance, not a functional gap

the near-375px tooltip-clipping justification for placing the clip on an inner layer is architecturally sound and structurally guaranteed (tooltip is a DOM sibling of the clip layer, not a descendant) but the specific 375px scenario invoked in the comment is not demonstrated by any screenshot or test
